To find the area, we compute the corresponding definite integral, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{c}^{d}x(y)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-3}^{-2}(24-6{y}^{2})\,\text{d}y \\  & =24{\int }_{-3}^{-2}\,\text{d}y\,-\,6{\int }_{-3}^{-2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y \\  & =24y\,{|}_{-3}^{-2}-2{y}^{3}\,{|}_{-3}^{-2} \\  & =24(-2-(-3))-2(-8-(-27)) \\  & =24-38 \\  & =-14\end{aligned}
$$

Since the region lies to the left of the $y$-axis, we obtained a negative number. So the area that we want is $|-14|=14.$
